learning_outcomes.text: Classifying the materials, knowing their advantages and disadvantages
Knowing material selection criteria and applying
Learning basic information about manufacturing techniques, design methods and material selection.

syllabus_topics: INTRODUCTION: Introduction to engineering materials, modern material needs.
PHASE DIAGRAMS: Phase diagrams, iron-iron carbide phase diagram.
PHASE DIAGRAMS: Isothermal transformation, continous cooling transformation.
HEAT TREATMENT OF STEELS: Hardenability, influence of quenching, medium, specimen size and geometry.
CERAMICS: Glasses, clay products and advanced ceramics.
COMPOSITES: Particle reinforced composites, fiber reinforced composites, processing of composites
MATERIALS SELECTION: Factors in materials selection, criteria for material selection
MATERIALS SELECTION: Performance and efficiency of materials
CORROSION: Electrochemical consideration, forms of corrosion.
bibliography: Brostow W., Lobland H.E.H., Materials: Introduction and Applications, Wiley, 2016.
W.D. Callister, Material Science and Engineering: An Introduction, John Wiley and Sons Inc., 2007.
